name: Lemon Skunk
summary: Lemon Skunk is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Green House Seed Co.]] from [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]] and a lemon-scented line the breeder calls Citral, which it describes as having Indian heritage. Some sources instead read Citral as [[chitral|Chitral]], a landrace from northwestern Pakistan. A separate Lemon Skunk line is sold by DNA Genetics.

sources.title: Lemon Skunk
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Skunk x Citral and describes Citral as having Indian heritage — this contradicts SeedFinder's speculative reading of 'Citral' as Chitral, Pakistan, so that identification is now presented as disputed rather than as fact, and Chitral is not listed as a structural parent.

sources.title: Lemon Skunk (Green House Seeds)
sources.note: Reads 'Citral' as probably Chitral, Pakistan; the source of the disputed reading in the summary.
